'''Fishing treasure''' is the most valuable category of [[fishing]] loot. It can only be caught when the bobber is in open water. Its weight is 5 with quality +1. The chance per catch in open water is 5% with no luck and 8% with {{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III, in any biome (see [[Fishing#Choosing the catch]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing.json}}</ref>

== Loot ==
Several entries have a quality, so Luck of the Sea shifts the odds toward chests and [[Crystal Heart]]s.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/treasure.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Item !! Count !! Weight !! Quality !! No luck !! Luck of the Sea I !! II !! III
|-
| {{ItemLink|Obol}} || 1–2 || 72 || 0 || 42.11% || 41.38% || 40.68% || 40%
|-
| Enchanted {{ItemLink|Fishing Rod}} || 1 || 42 || 0 || 24.56% || 24.14% || 23.73% || 23.33%
|-
| {{ItemLink|Hell-Bound Book}} || 1 || 30 || 0 || 17.54% || 17.24% || 16.95% || 16.67%
|-
| {{MCW|Angler Pottery Sherd}} || 1 || 15 || −1 || 8.77% || 8.05% || 7.34% || 6.67%
|-
| {{MCW|Goat Horn}} || 1 || 5 || −1 || 2.92% || 2.3% || 1.69% || 1.11%
|-
| {{ItemLink|Crystal Heart}} || 1 || 6 || +2 || 3.51% || 4.6% || 5.65% || 6.67%
|-
| {{ItemLink|Chest}} of buried treasure || 1 || 1 || +3 || 0.58% || 2.3% || 3.95% || 5.56%
|}

* The fishing rod is enchanted as if at level 30 and has only 0–25% of its durability left.
* The book is enchanted at level 30, giving a Hell-Bound Book.
* The goat horn can be any of the regular goat horn sounds.
* The chest is a chest item that holds a buried treasure loot table. When placed, it contains 2–4 [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]] (more with luck), 2 rolls of the treasure ores table, each giving 12–20 raw copper, 3–6 raw gold, 8–15 lapis lazuli, 8–15 raw iron and 1–3 raw diamonds<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/chests/common/treasure_ores.json}}</ref>, a 1 in 6 chance of 2 coast armor trim templates, a chance of copper, iron, gold or diamond nautilus armor, and a 2 in 3 chance of a sacred text ([[Paradise Lost]] or [[The Divine Comedy]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/chests/fishing/treasure.json}}</ref>

The developer made treasure rarer in 1.10 so that players who don't enjoy fishing don't feel pushed into it for loot.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=I want people who like fishing to be rewarded, I don't want people who don't enjoy fishing to put up with it just to get loot.}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.5-alpha|Added Crystal Hearts.}}
{{History line|1.10|Chests and Crystal Hearts made rarer, enchanted fishing rods more common. Buried treasure nerfed.}}
{{History line|1.12|Buried treasure buffed slightly.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Treasure tweaked. Sacred texts made rarer in the buried treasure. The release notes also say nautilus shells were added to it, but the current fishing chest has none.}}
{{History line|1.12.7-beta|Treasure went from 5% to 31.25% of open-water catches in biomes with fish, because the reworked biome entry has a weight of 1.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing.json|at=34a04e6571d9ee6f0cc1d8d50cdfa85980720156}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.8-beta|date=October 23, 2026|Back to 5% of open-water catches, as the biome tables weigh 85 again.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing.json|at=58e88dcec369fe3293fb25a15214249d116a100e}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.9|date=October 31, 2026|Treasure's quality lowered from +2 to +1, so Luck of the Sea III raises it to 8% of open-water catches instead of 11.34%.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing.json}}</ref>
Every treasure weight tripled except the goat horn's and the chest's, which makes those two rarer: a goat horn went from 8.2% to 2.92% of treasure and a chest from 1.64% to 0.58%.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/treasure.json}}</ref>}}
}}
